name: D'javol'skoe Iskushenie
source:
Naive guy Rob goes to purgatory to save his beloved. But the true test is not the gloomy subterranean depths, but seductive demonesses who are ready to take possession of his body and... soul.

Rob thought his noble deed - rescuing a girl from purgatory - would be a simple matter. But will he be able to resist the charms of the lustful demonesses who use all their wiles and charm to lead him astray?

What will win out in the end: his loyalty or sweet seduction? The trials Rob will go through for love will reveal his true character and willpower. But will his choices be the right ones in this dangerous world?

Discover a world where every encounter can change not only Rob's fate, but also his understanding of love and loyalty.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3318010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
天真的罗布为了拯救他心爱的人而前往炼狱。但真正的考验不是阴暗的地下深处，而是准备占领他的身体和……灵魂的诱人的恶魔。

罗布认为他的崇高行为——从炼狱中拯救一个女孩——会是一件简单的事情。但他能抵挡那些用尽一切诡计和魅力让他误入歧途的好色恶魔的魅力吗？

最终谁会胜出：他的忠诚还是甜蜜的诱惑？罗布为爱情所经历的考验将揭示他的真实性格和意志力。但在这个危险的世界里，他的选择是否正确呢？

探索一个世界，在这里，每一次遭遇不仅会改变罗布的命运，还会改变他对爱和忠诚的理解。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3318010/]Steam[/url]]
